component.name: NeoStego
component.summary: Hide data in images and audio, and watermark files

description.p: NeoStego is a steganography application with two functions: it hides any file inside an image or audio file, and it embeds invisible, password-keyed watermarks to detect unauthorized copying.

A modernized fork of OpenStego, it adds authenticated encryption (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM), detection-resistant content-adaptive algorithms (HILL+STC and SI-UNIWARD), robust blind DWT-SVD watermarking, audio (WAV) support, and a modern light/dark interface. Output stays format-compatible with OpenStego.

description.p: Extraction no longer reports a misleading "not a RIFF/WAVE container" audio error when a non-audio file is opened with the wrong password; it now routes by container type and surfaces the correct error. Desktop and Android share one extraction routine.
